title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: Review B8: student life words, -s and -es, vowel pairs, write about your university
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Sun 15 Nov (review B8)
intro: Seven steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Step 6 is writing: type it in the box on the website. Steps 3 and 7 are voice notes. Book work: do EPIU 42.2 again in your book and send a photo in the Zalo group.

steps.title: Step 1 · Lesson 8 words
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with a Lesson 8 word.

items.label: 1. The university ____ is very big. It has ten buildings and a lake.
2. She is a good student, so she won a ____.
3. The ____ for this English course is 5 million dong.
4. He is a ____. It is his first year at university.
5. We buy cheap noodles in the ____.
6. Four of us are working on a ____ about recycling.
7. I don't live at home. I live in a ____ on campus.
8. We meet in a ____ before every test.

steps.title: Step 2 · -s and -es review
steps.instructions: Write the he / she / it form.

steps.title: Step 3 · Sounds: vowel pairs
steps.instructions: Say each pair aloud 3 times. Make the two words sound different. Record one voice note.
steps.note: Teacher listens for short /ɪ/ vs long /iː/, /ʊ/ vs /uː/, /e/ vs /æ/, /ʌ/ vs /ɑː/, /eɪ/ vs /aɪ/, and the /ŋk/ in think.

items.q: 1. ____ does she go to the study group? — Twice a week.

options.A: He goes sometimes to the cafeteria.
options.B: He sometimes goes to the cafeteria.
options.C: Sometimes he go to the cafeteria.

items.q: 4. I go to the library ____. (Monday, Wednesday, Friday)

options.A: How often do your friend study?
options.B: How often does your friend study?
options.C: How often does your friend studies?

steps.title: Step 5 · Web words from Friday and Saturday
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with a word from Friday's or Saturday's list on the website.

items.label: 1. The weather ____ says it will rain tomorrow. (f)
2. It is very ____ in Hà Nội in August. The air is wet. (h)
3. My ____ helps me with my reports at work. (c)
4. She got a ____ and now she is the manager. (p)
5. He works ____ on busy days and goes home at 10 p.m. (o)

steps.title: Step 6 · Writing: my university
steps.instructions: Write about 40 words about your university or a friend's university. Use at least 3 Lesson 8 words. Type it in the box on the website.

open.model: I am a freshman at a university in Hà Nội. The campus is big and green. I live in a hall of residence. I usually eat lunch in the cafeteria. I meet my study group twice a week.

ai.task: Write about 40 words about your (or a friend's) university with at least 3 Lesson 8 words.
criteria: at least 3 Lesson 8 words used correctly

steps.title: Step 7 · Voice note
steps.instructions: Read your paragraph from Step 6 aloud once. Record one voice note.
lines: Read your paragraph from Step 6 aloud, slowly.
steps.note: Teacher listens for word stress in the Lesson 8 words.

send_today: Seven steps on the website. Voice notes are sent to the teacher when you press Submit. Photo of EPIU 42.2 in the Zalo group: Done + name + Sunday.
